1.visual: The international wheelchair accessibility symbol — a dynamic forward-leaning figure in a wheelchair with one arm extended.
1.usage: Accessibility settings, wheelchair-accessible location marker, disability accommodation notice, inclusive design indicator

2.visual: A calculator — a small rectangular device with a display area at the top and a grid of round buttons below.
2.usage: Math or calculation tool, expense calculator, numeric input, finance or accounting feature

3.visual: A plain empty circle outline — a simple unfilled ring with no marks, symbols, or decoration inside.
3.usage: Unselected radio button, empty state placeholder, step not started indicator, geometric primitive

4.visual: A coffee mug or teacup with a handle on the right and three steam wisps rising from the open top.
4.usage: Break time, café or food section, hot beverage context, idle or away status

5.visual: The copyright symbol — the letter C enclosed within a full circle border.
5.usage: Copyright notice, legal footer, content ownership label, rights reserved attribution

6.visual: A rounded plus sign — four equal thick arms forming a cross with smooth rounded ends, like a medical cross.
6.usage: Add new item, medical or health feature, first aid section, create or insert action

7.visual: A regular hexagon outline — a six-sided polygon with equal sides and no interior detail.
7.usage: Category badge, honeycomb grid cell, module icon, geometric design element

8.visual: The infinity symbol — a continuous figure-eight lying on its side forming two overlapping loops.
8.usage: Unlimited plan, infinite scroll, loop or repeat, no-expiry indicator

9.visual: A single leaf — a teardrop-shaped leaf outline with a pointed tip and a short curved stem.
9.usage: Eco or sustainability feature, nature theme, organic product label, green energy section

10.visual: A lightbulb — a rounded glass dome tapering to a base with two short horizontal lines suggesting the socket fitting.
10.usage: Idea or insight callout, tips section, suggestion prompt, innovation feature

11.visual: Three curved arrows forming a closed triangular loop, each arrow flowing into the next in a clockwise direction — the universal recycling symbol.
11.usage: Recycling option, refresh or reload, sustainability label, circular process indicator

12.visual: A square with generously rounded corners and no fill — an empty rounded-rectangle outline.
12.usage: Checkbox unchecked state, selectable card border, empty slot placeholder, container shape

13.visual: A bullseye target — three concentric rings with a solid dot at the center, all enclosed in a circle.
13.usage: Goal tracking, precision or focus setting, target audience indicator, campaign objective

14.visual: An upward-pointing triangle with rounded corners on all three vertices and a thick stroke, no fill.
14.usage: Scroll to top, ascending sort, increase value control, alert or warning indicator
